name: NRB Bearings Ltd
title: NRB Bearings Ltd - 530367 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin 19.5% and FY26 PAT up 77% to INR146 crore; management says reported utilisation ~85% with bottlenecks, brownfield capex of INR200 crore over 18 months, and FY27 capex closer to INR120 crore.

utilisation.quote: While reported utilization is roughly 85%, in reality effective utilization at several of our plants is much closer to full

capex.quote: No, it'll be closer INR 120 crores and the reason for that is we're also looking at land.

triggers.label: Reported utilisation ~85%, plants near full
triggers.quote: While reported utilization is roughly 85%, in reality effective utilization at several of our plants is much closer to full

triggers.label: Brownfield capex ~INR200 crore over 18 months
triggers.quote: we have already explained the 200 crore capex which will happen over next 18 months

triggers.label: International business growth 10-14% FY27
triggers.quote: we expect 10 to 14% growth in our international business this year, as per our current business plan

triggers.label: Gross margin dip blamed on forex
triggers.quote: Fundamentally only one reason, foreign exchange.

triggers.label: Repeated refusal to disclose export and capex split
triggers.quote: we don't like to give out too many numbers which are not in the public domain

guidance.quote: we expect 10 to 14% growth in our international business this year

red_flags.quote: So there was an aberration because of the exchange rate differential on the last day of the year.

red_flags.quote: NRB's improved inventory position is close to optimal at this point
